title: Quiz: Supply Chain Security for the Age of AI-Speed Exploits
description: Test your grasp of Python supply chain security, from startup hooks and lock files to dependency cooldowns, agent installs, and short-lived tokens.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Supply Chain Security for the Age of AI-Speed Exploits . By working through these questions, you’ll revisit how .pth files and sitecustomize.py run code during normal Python startup, how to inspect startup hooks without triggering them, what lock files and hashes give you, and why a dependency cooldown doesn’t replace an audit.
takeaways: By working through these questions, you’ll revisit how .pth files and sitecustomize.py run code during normal Python startup, how to inspect startup hooks without triggering them, what lock files and hashes give you, and why a dependency cooldown doesn’t replace an audit.
